in_sanskrit.name: Anvith
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Desire, Intention, Will
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anvith एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Anvith is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anushtita', which means 'one who has accomplished or achieved his desires'. It is a powerful name that signifies determination, willpower, and intention.
